mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.member_id, pc.name AS category_name, p.title, p.view_count, p.like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED') AS comment_count, p.created_at
FROM posts p JOIN post_categories pc ON pc.id = p.category_id
ORDER BY p.view_count DESC, p.id DESC
ORDER BY p.like_count DESC, p.id DESC
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE posts p SET p.view_count = p.view_count + 1, p.updated_at = p.updated_at WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND #{viewerKey} IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post_views pv WHERE pv.post_id = p.id AND pv.viewer_key = #{viewerKey} AND pv.created_at > NOW(6) - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE )
mapper.select:
SELECT pc.id, pc.code, pc.name
FROM post_categories pc WHERE pc.is_active = 1 ORDER BY pc.sort_order, pc.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (member_id, category_id, title, content, status) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{content}, 'PUBLISHED')
mapper.select:
SELECT p.member_id, p.status
FROM posts p WHERE p.id = #{postId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE posts p SET p.like_count = p.like_count + 1, p.updated_at = p.updated_at WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post_likes pl WHERE pl.post_id = p.id AND pl.member_id = #{memberId} )

UPDATE posts p SET p.like_count = p.like_count - 1, p.updated_at = p.updated_at WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post_likes pl WHERE pl.post_id = p.id AND pl.member_id = #{memberId} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_reports (post_id, reporter_id, reason, status) VALUES (#{postId}, #{reporterId}, #{reason}, 'PENDING')
